title: Track Internet Identity logins and show owner-only list of logged-in principals

requirements.text: Add backend support to record Internet Identity logins by principal ID whenever a user authenticates with Internet Identity.

quotes: I want to be seeing all my user login info in my website after they register.
Only to me after they login yes only internet identity
Build and keep every other thing intact

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a new shared method that, when called by an authenticated Internet Identity user, records the caller principal ID as having logged in.
The recorded data includes at minimum: principal ID (as Principal), firstSeen timestamp, lastSeen timestamp, and a loginCount (incremented on subsequent calls).
Calling the tracking method as an anonymous principal is rejected with a clear error (trap) indicating authentication is required.
Existing backend methods and behavior (createAccount/login/listAllAccounts/admin session endpoints) remain functional and unchanged for their current callers.

requirements.text: Add a backend admin-only query endpoint that returns the list of Internet Identity login records (principal IDs and associated timestamps/count), accessible only to the site owner/admin.

quotes: Only to me after they login yes only internet identity

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a new query method that returns a list/array of recorded Internet Identity login records.
The query enforces admin-only access using the existing authorization model in backend/main.mo (e.g., AccessControl.isAdmin).
If a non-admin calls the query, it fails with an Unauthorized error message consistent with existing patterns (trap).
Returned records include principal ID as text (or can be converted on the frontend) plus firstSeen/lastSeen and loginCount.

requirements.text: Implement a frontend Internet Identity login tracker that calls the backend tracking method once per Internet Identity login session, without modifying any immutable files.

quotes: Build and keep every other thing intact

acceptanceCriteria: A new non-immutable component/hook is added that observes the current Internet Identity principal (via existing hooks) and triggers a backend call to record the login when the principal becomes non-anonymous.
The tracker avoids spamming: for the same principal it records at most once per browser session (e.g., using sessionStorage) unless the user logs out and logs back in.
The tracker does not block navigation or disrupt existing pages if the tracking call fails (fail silently or show only a console warning).
No edits are made to any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.

requirements.text: Extend the existing owner/admin-only UI to display a table of all Internet Identity principals that have logged in, visible only to the site owner/admin, while keeping existing site behavior intact.

quotes: you (the site owner) should be able to see a list of every user who has logged in, identified by their principal ID
Build and keep every other thing intact

acceptanceCriteria: The existing protected admin area at /users continues to work as it currently does.
The /users admin page adds a new section (or a clear toggle) that shows the Internet Identity login list returned by the new backend query.
The Internet Identity login list displays at least: principal ID, firstSeen, lastSeen, and loginCount, with sensible formatting for timestamps.
If the viewer is not authorized, the page continues to show an access denied experience and does not reveal principal IDs.
All user-facing text for the new section is in English.

constraints: Keep every other existing feature and behavior intact; changes must be additive and localized to the new Internet Identity login tracking and admin listing functionality.
Do not edit any files under frontend.immutablePaths (including frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts and frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts).
Do not introduce additional backend canisters/services; keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Internet Identity does not provide personal details; only principal IDs (and any derived login metadata like timestamps/count) should be stored/shown unless explicitly added later.
nonGoals: Do not add custom registration fields (name/email/profile picture) for Internet Identity users.
Do not implement third-party authentication providers; Internet Identity only.
Do not change or redesign the existing plans signup/login system or account tables beyond adding the new Internet Identity login listing section.
Do not build real-time updates (no websockets/push); the admin list can refresh via normal queries.

preferencesToAdd: Use English for any user-facing text.
